findings.title: Form control lacks a detectable accessible name
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.remediation: Use an associated visible <label>, or an appropriate accessible name where necessary.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 4, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > input:nth-of-type(2); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.

findings.title: Button lacks a detectable accessible name
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.remediation: Add visible button text or an appropriate accessible name.

findings.title: Image is missing alt attribute
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.remediation: Provide an appropriate alt text, or alt="" for genuinely decorative imagery.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 6, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > img:nth-of-type(1); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.

findings.title: Invalid form control lacks a detectable error association
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.detail: aria-invalid is true; no programmatic error reference detected in source.
findings.remediation: Associate clear error text using aria-describedby or aria-errormessage and verify the message is announced.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 4, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > input:nth-of-type(2); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.

findings.title: Clickable nonsemantic element needs keyboard review
findings.priorityBasis: Rule severity heuristic only; actual task impact requires human review
findings.remediation: Use a native button or link; manually verify keyboard activation and focus.
findings.reproduce: Inspect signup-broken.html line 6, html:nth-of-type(1) > body:nth-of-type(1) > main:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1); confirm in a rendered browser and with affected users.
